Learning Objectives

By the end of this course, you should be able to:

  • Understand the fundamental concepts
  • Apply the techniques in practical settings
  • Evaluate different approaches to problem-solving

Course Structure

The course is structured around weekly lectures and practical sessions. Assessment will be through a combination of:

  • Weekly practical exercises
  • Mid-term quiz
  • Final project
